content: GitOps bootstrap chicken-and-egg: sealed-secrets controller must run before SealedSecrets decrypt; ESO needs SecretStore creds; ArgoCD repo creds themselves are a secret. Common homelab fix: SOPS+age with one offline private key to bootstrap, or manual kubectl apply of a small bootstrap secret set, then let sealed-secrets/ESO take over. Sealed-secrets private key loss = all sealed secrets unrecoverable; must back up controller key. Sources: argo-cd docs secret-management, jonashietala.se 2026, redhat blog.
